# dist/

Build output. `QuickPhrase.dotm` is generated here by:

```bash
python3 build/pack.py pack
```

It is gitignored — the sources it is built from live in `package/` and `src/`.
See [docs/DEVELOPING.md](../docs/DEVELOPING.md).

Want a ready-to-install file? Grab it from the
[Releases page](https://github.com/cenaav/QuickPhrase/releases).
